PENANCEMOD-STRIKE_PENANCE.title: Strike
PENANCEMOD-DEFEND_PENANCE.title: Defend
PENANCEMOD-ADJOURN.title: Adjourn
PENANCEMOD-ADJOURN.description:
End your turn.
Gain {Magic:diff()} [gold]Barrier[/gold] for each card played this turn.
(If your HP is below 50%, heal {Magic:diff()} HP instead.)
PENANCEMOD-AMBUSH_SHADOW.title: Umbral Ambush
PENANCEMOD-ART_OF_THE_HIDING_FOX.title: La Volpe Nascosta
PENANCEMOD-ART_OF_THE_HIDING_FOX.descrip:
Skip your turn. Gain {Fox-Magic()} [gold]Strength[/gold], [gold]Judgment[/gold], and [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold]. Gain {Fox-Barrier()} [gold]Barrier[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
[purple][gold]Retain[/gold] your hand and Energy this turn.[/purple]|}
PENANCEMOD-ASCETICISM.title: Asceticism
PENANCEMOD-ASCETICISM.description: Whenever your [gold]Barrier[/gold] takes damage, gain {Asceticism-Magic:diff()} [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-A_SIP.title: A Sip
PENANCEMOD-A_SIP.description:
Lose {ASip-Penalty:diff()} [gold]Barrier[/gold]. If insufficient, lose HP instead.
Gain 2 [gold]Strength[/gold].
Add a copy of this card to your hand. It is [gold]Ethereal[/gold] and the loss amount is increased by 2.
PENANCEMOD-BARBED_REBUKE.title: Barbed Rebuke
PENANCEMOD-BARBED_REBUKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Compare the target's [gold]Weak[/gold] and your [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold] stacks, and increase the lower stack to match the higher one.
PENANCEMOD-BLOOD_DEBT_CLAUSE.title: Blood Debt Clause
PENANCEMOD-BLOOD_DEBT_CLAUSE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
For each living enemy, put a random [gold]Wolfpack Curse[/gold] into your discard pile.
PENANCEMOD-BLOOD_FOR_BLOOD.title: Blood for Blood
PENANCEMOD-BREAK_THE_SHACKLES.title: Break the Shackles
PENANCEMOD-BREAK_THE_SHACKLES.descriptio:
Gain 3 [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold].
Gain additional [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold] equal to {Shackles-Percent:diff()}% of your current [gold]Judgment[/gold].{DynamicTotalText}
PENANCEMOD-BURDENED_JOURNEY.title: Burdened Journey
PENANCEMOD-CASE_RECONSTRUCTION.title: Case Reconstruction
PENANCEMOD-CASTIGATION.title: Castigation
PENANCEMOD-CENSURE.title: Censure
PENANCEMOD-CITATION_OF_LAW.title: Citation of Law
PENANCEMOD-CITATION_OF_LAW.description:
Gain {Citation-Base:diff()} [gold]Barrier[/gold].
Then, gain [gold]Barrier[/gold] equal to {Citation-Percent:diff()}% of your current [gold]Barrier[/gold].{DynamicTotal}
PENANCEMOD-CODE_OF_REVENGE.title: Code of Revenge
PENANCEMOD-CODE_STRIKE.title: Code Smash
PENANCEMOD-CODE_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for every 7 unblocked damage dealt.
PENANCEMOD-CONSULT_THE_DOSSIER.title: Consult Dossier
PENANCEMOD-CONSULT_THE_DOSSIER.descripti:
Draw {Consult-Draw:diff()} cards.
Whenever you draw a [gold]Skill[/gold] card, gain {Consult-Judge:diff()} [gold]Judgment[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-CONTINUOUS_RAIN.title: Unrelenting Downpour
PENANCEMOD-CONTINUOUS_RAIN.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL characters.
{IfUpgraded:show:Apply {Rain-EnemyDebuff:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies, and {Rain-SelfDebuff:diff()} to yourself.|Apply {Rain-EnemyDebuff:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL characters.}
PENANCEMOD-COURT_REHEARSAL.title: Court Rehearsal
PENANCEMOD-COURT_REHEARSAL.description: While in your hand, transforms into a random {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Upgraded[/gold] |}card each turn.
PENANCEMOD-CROWN_OF_THORNS.title: Crown of Thorns
PENANCEMOD-CROWN_OF_THORNS.description: At the start of your turn, lose 2 HP, gain {Crown-Magic:diff()} [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold], and apply {Crown-Magic:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
PENANCEMOD-CUMULATIVE_PRECEDENT.title: Cumulative Precedent
PENANCEMOD-CUMULATIVE_PRECEDENT.descript: Whenever you play a [gold]Skill[/gold] card, gain {Cumulative-Magic:diff()} [gold]Barrier[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-DEADLY_ENEMY.title: Deadly Enemy
PENANCEMOD-DEADLY_ENEMY.description: While this card is in your hand, you take 1 additional damage from all sources.
PENANCEMOD-DIGNITY_OF_THE_LEADER.title: Packleader's Dignity
PENANCEMOD-EMERGENCY_REPAIR.title: Emergency Repair
PENANCEMOD-FAME_OF_THE_CROWN_SLAYER.desc:
Give ALL enemies {Fame-TempStr:diff()} Temporary [gold]Strength[/gold].
Draw {Fame-Draw:diff()} cards.
PENANCEMOD-FAMILY_ARBITRATION.title: Family Arbitration
PENANCEMOD-FAMILY_ARBITRATION.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Place a random [gold]Wolfpack Curse[/gold] into your discard pile.
PENANCEMOD-FINALE_CATASTROPHE.title: Finale: Catastrofe
PENANCEMOD-FINALE_CATASTROPHE.descriptio: Deal {Finale-Hits:diff()} damage randomly distributed among ALL characters (including you).{IfUpgraded:show: Now has a higher chance to hit enemies!|}
PENANCEMOD-FINAL_VERDICT.title: Final Verdict
PENANCEMOD-FINAL_VERDICT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage (affected by [gold]Judgment[/gold]).{DynamicJudgeText}
If this kills a non-Minion enemy, gain {Verdict-MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
PENANCEMOD-FLAIL_SMASH.title: Last Word
PENANCEMOD-FORCED_SUMMONS.title: Forced Summons
PENANCEMOD-FORCED_SUMMONS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw 1 card. If the target intends to [gold]Attack[/gold], draw 2 cards instead.
PENANCEMOD-GAVEL_BARRAGE.title: Gavel Barrage
PENANCEMOD-GAVEL_BARRAGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to random enemies {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} times.
Whenever you deal damage, gain 1 [gold]Judgment[/gold] and 1 [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-GLOW_OF_SUFFERING.title: Glow of Suffering
PENANCEMOD-GLOW_OF_SUFFERING.description: Whenever you lose HP from a card effect, gain [gold]Barrier[/gold] and [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold] equal to {Glow-Mult:diff()} times the amount lost.
PENANCEMOD-GUARDIAN_OF_THE_LAW.title: Guardian of Law
PENANCEMOD-GUILTY_AS_CHARGED.title: Guilty as Charged!
PENANCEMOD-GUILTY_AS_CHARGED.description:
Remove the target's [gold]Block[/gold].
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
For each [gold]Curse[/gold] card in all your piles, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
PENANCEMOD-HOUR_OF_RECKONING.title: Hour of Reckoning
PENANCEMOD-HOUR_OF_RECKONING.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.{DynamicHpLostText}
Damage is increased by 1 for each HP you have lost this combat.
PENANCEMOD-IMMEDIATE_EXECUTION.title: Immediate Execution
PENANCEMOD-IMMEDIATE_EXECUTION.descripti:
Gain {Execution-Judge:diff()} [gold]Judgment[/gold].
Deal damage equal to your [gold]Judgment[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-IN_THE_NAME_OF_THE_LAW.title: In the Name of Law
PENANCEMOD-IN_THE_NAME_OF_THE_LAW.descri: When [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold] is triggered, it also applies {Law-Weak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to the target.
PENANCEMOD-IRONCLAD_DOCTRINE.title: Ironclad Doctrine
PENANCEMOD-IRONCLAD_DOCTRINE.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Consume[/gold] {Doctrine-Cost:diff()} [gold]Barrier[/gold] to heal 3 HP.
PENANCEMOD-JOINT_LIABILITY.title: Joint Liability
PENANCEMOD-JOINT_LIABILITY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.{DynamicJudgeText}
Damage is increased by 1 for each [gold]Judgment[/gold] you have.
PENANCEMOD-JUDGEMENT_BACKLASH.title: Judgment Backlash
PENANCEMOD-JUDGEMENT_BACKLASH.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Trigger this effect again for every 3 [gold]Judgment[/gold] you have.
PENANCEMOD-JUDGMENT_HAS_BEGUN.title: Judgment Has Begun
PENANCEMOD-JUDGMENT_HAS_BEGUN.descriptio: Whenever you play an [gold]Attack[/gold] card this turn, gain 5 [gold]Barrier[/gold], 1 [gold]Strength[/gold], and 1 [gold]Judgment[/gold]. After playing 3, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)}.
PENANCEMOD-JUDICIAL_DISCRETION.title: Judicial Discretion
PENANCEMOD-JUSTIFIED_RETALIATION.title: Justified Retaliation
PENANCEMOD-LAST_STAND.title: Last Stand
PENANCEMOD-LAW_ENFORCEMENT.title: Law Enforcement
PENANCEMOD-LAW_ENFORCEMENT.description:
Deal damage equal to {Law-Percent:diff()}% of your current [gold]Barrier[/gold].{DynamicDamageText}
If this base damage is less than 10, gain [gold]Barrier[/gold] equal to twice that amount.
PENANCEMOD-LAW_IS_CANON.title: Law is Canon
PENANCEMOD-LAW_IS_CANON.description: At the end of your turn, if you have [gold]Barrier[/gold], trigger [gold]Judgment[/gold] 1 time on a random enemy.
PENANCEMOD-LAW_MODIFICATION.title: Law Modification
PENANCEMOD-NO_SENTENCE_NEEDED.title: No Sentence Needed
PENANCEMOD-NO_SENTENCE_NEEDED.descriptio:
Can only be played if your [gold]Barrier[/gold] is 0.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
PENANCEMOD-NO_SENTENCE_NEEDED.cant_use_m: I can only play this card when my [gold]Barrier[/gold] is 0.
PENANCEMOD-OVERRULE.title: Overrule
PENANCEMOD-OVERRULE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply 1 [gold]Weak[/gold].
If the target already has [gold]Weak[/gold], double its stacks.
PENANCEMOD-PENALTY_REGRESSION.title: Penalty Regression
PENANCEMOD-PENALTY_REGRESSION.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Reduce all your Debuff stacks by 1.
PENANCEMOD-PERJURY.title: Perjury
PENANCEMOD-PRE_EXECUTION_PREP.title: Pre-Execution Prep
PENANCEMOD-PROCEDURAL_JUSTICE.title: Procedural Justice
If you haven't played an [gold]Attack[/gold] card this turn, gain {Transgression-Amt:diff()} [gold]Self-Defense[/gold] at the end of your turn.
PENANCEMOD-QUELL.title: Quell
PENANCEMOD-QUELL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have [gold]Barrier[/gold], apply {Quell-Weak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-READ_CHARGES.title: Read Charges
PENANCEMOD-SCENE_INVESTIGATION.title: Scene Investigation
PENANCEMOD-SELF_INCRIMINATION.title: Self-Incrimination
PENANCEMOD-SELF_INCRIMINATION.descriptio:
Draw a [gold]Curse[/gold] card from your draw pile.
Add an {IfUpgraded:show:Upgraded |}[gold]Evidence[/gold] and an {IfUpgraded:show:Upgraded |}[gold]Perjury[/gold] into your hand.
PENANCEMOD-SILENCE.title: Silence
PENANCEMOD-SILENCE.description:
Gain {Silence-Barrier:diff()} [gold]Barrier[/gold].
If your HP is below 50%, gain 3 additional [gold]Judgment[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-SILENCE_WRATH.title: Silent Wrath
PENANCEMOD-SILENCE_WRATH.description:
Whenever your [gold]Barrier[/gold] is attacked, apply {SilenceWrath-Amt:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to the attacker.
When your [gold]Barrier[/gold] is broken, gain {SilenceWrath-Amt:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-SOLID_DEFENSE.title: Solid Defense
PENANCEMOD-STING.title: Sting
PENANCEMOD-SYRACUSAN_WOLVES.title: Syracusan Wolves
PENANCEMOD-SYRACUSAN_WOLVES.description: Shuffle 5 random {IfUpgraded:show:Upgraded |}[gold]Wolfpack Curses[/gold] into your draw pile.
PENANCEMOD-RESOLUTE.title: Resolute
PENANCEMOD-TANGLED_THREADS.title: Lockstitch
PENANCEMOD-TEMPERING.title: Tempering
PENANCEMOD-THE_TRIAL.title: The Trial
PENANCEMOD-THE_TRIAL.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Strength[/gold] affects this card multiplicatively.
PENANCEMOD-THORNY_PATH.title: Trial of Thorns
PENANCEMOD-THORNY_PATH.description: At the end of your turn, if the enemy has [gold]Weak[/gold], gain {ThornyPath-Amt:diff()} [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-TIPPING_SCALES.title: Tipping Scales
PENANCEMOD-TOOTH_FOR_TOOTH.title: Tooth for Tooth
PENANCEMOD-TOOTH_FOR_TOOTH.description:
Lose 2 HP.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Shuffle a [gold]Wolfpack Curse[/gold] into your discard pile.
If your HP is below 50%, draw {Tooth-Draw:diff()} cards.
PENANCEMOD-UNWAVERING.title: Stoic Atonement
PENANCEMOD-UNWAVERING.description:
Whenever you play an [gold]Attack[/gold] card, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
You take 30% less damage.
At the end of your turn, gain {Unwavering-Thorns:diff()} [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-UPRIGHT.title: Upright
PENANCEMOD-UPRIGHT.description:
Gain {Upright-Str:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
(Based on total [gold]Curse[/gold] cards in all zones)
PENANCEMOD-WALL_BREAKER_SMASH.title: Wallbreaker Smash
PENANCEMOD-WEIGHT_OF_LAW.title: Weight of Law
PENANCEMOD-UNWRITTEN_LAW.title: Unwritten Law
PENANCEMOD-UNWRITTEN_LAW.description:
Draw a random [gold]Power[/gold] card from your draw pile.
If you play it this turn, play it twice.
PENANCEMOD-PURGE.title: Purge
PENANCEMOD-PURGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Gain [gold]Barrier[/gold] equal to unblocked damage dealt.
PENANCEMOD-WEAK_AND_WEEP.title: Weak and Weep
PENANCEMOD-WEAK_AND_WEEP.description: For each [gold]Weak[/gold] the target has, trigger [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold] damage once on them.
PENANCEMOD-SETTLING_OLD_SCORES.title: Settling Old Scores
PENANCEMOD-SETTLING_OLD_SCORES.descripti: Draw {Settling-Draw:diff()} cards, automatically play the [gold]Attack[/gold] cards among them and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] them. Repeat this until you draw 2 non-[gold]Attack[/gold] cards, or a total of drawing 10 cards.
PENANCEMOD-WAND_ANTIGRAVITY.title: Arcane Staff - Anti-Gravity Mode
PENANCEMOD-WAND_ANTIGRAVITY.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] all [gold]Curse[/gold] cards not in the exhaust pile.
For each {IfUpgraded:show:card|[gold]Curse[/gold] card} in the exhaust pile, add a random [gold]Wolfpack Curse[/gold] to your discard pile.
PENANCEMOD-UNYIELD.title: Unyielding
PENANCEMOD-DESTRUCTION_BEFORE_CREATION.d:
Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a [gold]Curse[/gold] card, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.
At the start of each turn, shuffle a random [gold]Wolfpack Curse[/gold] into your discard pile.
PENANCEMOD-COURT_MAJESTY.title: Court Majesty
PENANCEMOD-COURT_MAJESTY.description: Enemies with [gold]Weak[/gold] deal 25% less damage to your [gold]Barrier[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-GUILT_BOUND_AURA.title: Guilt-Bound Aura
PENANCEMOD-BAD_OPERA.title: Bad Opera
PENANCEMOD-BAD_OPERA.description:
Randomly [gold]Exhaust[/gold] up to {Opera-CurseCount:diff()} [gold]Curse[/gold] cards from your draw pile.
For each card exhausted, gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 2 [gold]Judgment[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-GAVEL_STRIKE.title: Gavel Strike
PENANCEMOD-GAVEL_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain [gold]Barrier[/gold] equal to the target's [gold]Weak[/gold] stacks.
PENANCEMOD-PENDING_JUDGMENT.title: Pending Judgment
PENANCEMOD-PENDING_JUDGMENT.description: Apply {Pending-Weak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies. For each enemy with [gold]Weak[/gold], gain {Pending-Barrier:diff()} [gold]Barrier[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-INESCAPABLE_NET.title: Inescapable Net
PENANCEMOD-INESCAPABLE_NET.description: The next {InescapableNet-Triggers:diff()} times you lose HP, if you have a total of [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold] or [gold]Judgment[/gold] not less than that amount, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] an equal amount of [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold] or [gold]Judgment[/gold], and heal the same amount of HP.
PENANCEMOD-MALICIOUS_COMPETITION.title: Malicious Competition
PENANCEMOD-MALICIOUS_COMPETITION.descrip: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the top {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Curse[/gold] |}card of your draw pile and gain {Malicious-Barrier:diff()} [gold]Barrier[/gold] and {Malicious-Judge:diff()} [gold]Judgment[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-OBJECTION.title: Objection!
PENANCEMOD-OBJECTION.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you have at least {Objection-Cost:diff()} [gold]Judgment[/gold], [gold]Exhaust[/gold] {Objection-Cost:diff()} [gold]Judgment[/gold] to apply 1 [gold]Armistice[/gold] to the target.
PENANCEMOD-JURY_ENTRY.title: Jury Entry
PENANCEMOD-JURY_ENTRY.description:
Choose 1 of 3 random [gold]Wolfpack Curses[/gold] to shuffle into your draw pile.
Gain {Jury-Barrier:diff()} [gold]Barrier[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-EXHIBIT_A.title: Evidence
PENANCEMOD-EXHIBIT_A.description:
{IfUpgraded:show:Choose to |Randomly }[gold]Exhaust[/gold] 2 cards from your hand.
Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)}.
PENANCEMOD-BIDE_TIME.title: Bide Time
PENANCEMOD-BIDE_TIME.description: Whenever you do not play an [gold]Attack[/gold] card in a turn, gain {Bide-Vigor:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-EXCOMMUNICATION.title: Excommunication
PENANCEMOD-EXCOMMUNICATION.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] all [gold]Curse[/gold] cards in your draw pile, hand, and discard pile.
For each card exhausted, gain {Excom-Barrier:diff()} [gold]Barrier[/gold] and {Excom-Str:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-INVIOLABLE.title: Inviolable
PENANCEMOD-DRINK_POISON.title: Drink Poison
PENANCEMOD-DRINK_POISON.description:
Lose {Drink-Loss:diff()} HP. Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}. Draw 1 card.
Add a copy of this card to your hand. It is [gold]Ethereal[/gold] and the HP lost is increased by 2.
PENANCEMOD-WOLF_FEAST.title: Feast of Wolves
PENANCEMOD-WOLF_FEAST.description: Choose 3 {IfUpgraded:show:Upgraded |}[gold]Wolfpack Curses[/gold] from all choices and play them.
PENANCEMOD-TEST_THE_LAW.title: Test the Law
PENANCEMOD-TEST_THE_LAW.description:
Set your HP to 10. If your HP decreases from this, gain 3 times the reduced amount as [gold]Barrier[/gold].
This combat, whenever you lose HP from a card effect, heal the same amount and gain that amount of [gold]Barrier[/gold] (also storing it in the relic), then gain 2 [gold]Judgment[/gold] and [gold]Thorn Aura[/gold].
PENANCEMOD-PREEMPTIVE_STRIKE.title: Preemptive Strike
PENANCEMOD-PREEMPTIVE_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
For the next {Strike-Turns:diff()} turns, gain 3 [gold]Self-Defense[/gold] at the start of your turn.
PENANCEMOD-STAND_AS_EQUALS.title: Stand As Equals
PENANCEMOD-STAND_AS_EQUALS.description: Gain {StandAsEquals-Barrier:diff()} [gold]Barrier[/gold]. Then, evenly distribute all your [gold]Barrier[/gold] among all teammates.
